0022600175.text: The Celtics (5-2, 4-0 at home) host the Bucks (1-6, on a three-game losing streak) in Boston's eighth game of the season, with Boston 1.5 games back of first place in the Atlantic. Boston is missing Paul George, who is out for rest after averaging 20.7 points and 31.0 minutes per game this season, and Devin Carter, who is out with illness and averaged 8.9 points and 18.4 minutes per game last season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
